confirms: dual_thrust_1642 venue_4h group (verdict inconclusive: 18 held-out position clusters < 30; every performance check passed)
status: frozen before acquisition; run_study.py lock records this file's sha256, the screen, the input inventory, every input file and every scoring source file before any leg is scored, and run refuses any difference
contract_note: The candidate, both comparators and all eight M1 incumbents run under this one contract (the dual_thrust_1642 matched contract): direction both, one tiered_tp_pct close at +3% for the full position, one fixed 1.0 x entry-ATR stop, strict close capability checks, ohlc_walk, $1,000 per leg and the manifest execution specification.

incumbent_params_source.note: the original results.json records this commit and this registry.py sha256; incumbent_params are the default_params of the eight incumbents read from that commit, and every leg receives them explicitly

stress_note: cost x2 doubles the per-coin half spread and the slippage; fees stay fixed
warmup_note: the 300 consecutive bars immediately before each window feed indicators only; the evaluator neither scores nor trades them

primary_4h.roster: the coins the screen selects (screen.json), excluding BTC, ETH and SOL

forward_4h.role: descriptive: original coins on bars after every original window; contributes nothing to the verdict
forward_4h.start_note: the original venue test window ended on 2026-09-01 and its proxy oos window on 2026-10-01; forward scoring starts at 2026-10-01

descriptive_1h.role: descriptive: the 1h arm; contributes nothing to the verdict
descriptive_1h.roster: the selected primary coins plus BTC, ETH and SOL; a 1h coverage failure is recorded and never removes a primary coin

acquisition.source: POST https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info: metaAndAssetCtxs (liquidity and venue meta), candleSnapshot (closed bars only), fundingHistory through shared_tools/funding_fetcher.py, l2Book (one snapshot per coin for the half spread)
acquisition.errors: a request that fails after its retries stops the acquisition before any file is written; no coin is skipped or replaced because of a fetch error

screen.liquidity_source: the dayNtlVlm (24h notional volume, USD) field of one recorded metaAndAssetCtxs response; the observation time and the raw response are frozen in data/venue/
screen.universe: every perpetual in that response's meta universe (the main dex) without isDelisted
screen.rank: dayNtlVlm descending, ties broken by coin name ascending; a non-finite volume is excluded
screen.rule: walk the ranking in order; screen each coin's 4h candles and hourly funding; select a coin when every requirement holds; stop after max_coins selections; coins below the last selection are not screened
requirements: listing history and warm-up: the 300 4h bars immediately before 2025-09-01 are all present on the UTC 4h grid

candles: every 4h bar in [2025-09-01, 2026-11-01) is present on the grid, with no extra bar, and every warm-up and window bar has finite positive open, high, low and close, high >= max(open, close), low <= min(open, close) and finite volume >= 0
funding: every UTC hour in [2025-09-01, 2026-11-01) has a finite funding rate
screen.named_candidates: HYPE and BNB receive the same screen with no priority
screen.forbidden_inputs: the screen reads only liquidity, listing and coverage information; it never computes a strategy signal, position, cluster or return
screen.fixed_after_screen: no coin or window is added, removed, replaced or extended after the screen; a failure to establish a primary roster is kept as evidence and yields an inconclusive verdict

sample_rules.cluster_definition: candidate base-cost positions pooled across the primary datasets, sorted by entry time; a position whose entry is at or before the running end of the current cluster (overlapping or touching holding spans) joins it, otherwise it starts a new cluster; per-coin cluster counts are reported separately and never summed into the pooled total

verdict_rule.population: primary_4h only; forward_4h and descriptive_1h never contribute datasets, clusters, metrics or checks
order: 1. evidence: inconclusive when the primary manifest provenance is not venue; the manifest roster differs from the screen roster; any primary dataset fails the candle, warm-up or funding checks; any candidate, comparator or incumbent leg is missing, errored, duplicated or unexpected at either cost; any leg's candle or funding coverage is incomplete; any required metric is non-finite; or the candidate entry audit fails
2. sample: inconclusive when pooled candidate base-cost clusters < 30
3. performance: pass only when every check is true; fail when any check is false

checks.net_positive_base: candidate summed net PnL > 0 at cost x1
checks.net_positive_stress: candidate summed net PnL > 0 at cost x2
checks.m1_pass_base: eval_windows.score_candidate verdict pass at cost x1 against the median of all eight incumbents per dataset (incumbent evidence is checked complete before the median is taken)
checks.beats_breakout_sharpe_base: candidate mean Sharpe > breakout mean Sharpe at cost x1, compared before display rounding
checks.beats_session_breakout_sharpe_base: candidate mean Sharpe > session_breakout mean Sharpe at cost x1, compared before display rounding

calendar_overlap: the primary window repeats the original venue test calendar from 2025-09-01 to 2026-09-01 (12 of its 14 months) on different coins, and its warm-up reads July and August 2025 bars that fall in the original train calendar; crypto returns are correlated across coins, so the confirmation is cross-sectional and not independent in time
metadata: no outcome changes registry metadata (edge_status stays no_edge, edge_source stays study_fail), strategy defaults, live or paper configuration, acknowledgements or deployment decisions; every command is suggest-only and sends no order
